text: Say - O Messenger, to these polytheists -: which thing is the greatest testimony in proving my truthfulness in what I have informed you of, that I am the Messenger of Allah? Say: Allah is a witness between me and you, meaning: He is the Knower of what I have brought to you and what you will say to me, and Allah revealed to me this Quran in order that I may warn you with it of His punishment that it may befall you, and warn with it whoever of the nations it reaches. Indeed, you acknowledge that with Allah there are other deities that you associate with Him. Say to them - O Messenger -: I do not testify to what you acknowledge, rather Allah is one God with no partner, and I am free of every partner you worship with Him.
